Name: Eelevate
Effect: This Pokémon has immunity to Ground-Type moves and effects active on the battlefield such as Terrains and certain Entry Hazards. If a foe faints because of an attack dealt by this Pokémon, Increase by 1 an Attribute/Trait of your choosing.
Description: The Pokémon levitates above ground in a slithering motion. It takes great satisfaction to see its enemies fall to the ground.
